PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES
  SEPTEMBER 17, 2024 MEETING

Commission Members Present: Larry Giannone (Chair), Bob Olander, Karol Curtis, Patrick
Jones, Orlando Pimental, Greg Tober, Ruth Luevand

Commission Members Absent: None

City Representatives: City Manager Chris Constantin, Captain Walid Ashranfnia
  • Motion by Curtis, seconded by Jones to excuse the absence of Commissioner Bob
  Olander due to illness. Motion carried (6-0).

 ORAL COMMUNICATIONS  COMMENTS/RECOMMENDATIONS
  None.

 BUSINESS ITEMS  COMMENTS/RECOMMENDATIONS
 BI.1 Approval of Minutes for March 21, 2023 and  MOTION: Motion by Commissioner Patrick
 May 21, 2024 Public Safety Commission (City  Jones and seconded by Commissioner
 Manager Chris Constantin)  Orlando Pimental to approve the minutes of
  March 21, 2023 and May 21, 2024. Motion
  passed 6-0.

 BI.2 Discussion of Part 1 Crimes for January to  Captain Ashrafnia provided an update on part
 July 2024 (Captain Walid Ashrafnia)  1 crime statistics for January to July 2024 as
  compared the same period in 2023. Total Part
  1 crime was up 2.3%. Aggravated assaults
  are down but robberies are up. Burglary and
  auto thefts are down, but petty thefts are up.
  LASD is paying close attention to robberies of
  which the majority are strong arm robberies.

 NEW BUSINESS ITEMS  COMMENTS/RECOMMENDATIONS
 NB.1 Discussion of Bridge Fire (Captain Walid  City Manager Constantin and Captain
 Ashrafnia and City Manager Chris Constantin)  Ashrafnia updated the commission on the
  status of the Bridge Fire and risk exposure to
  the City of San Dimas.

 REPORTS  COMMENTS/RECOMMENDATIONS
 R1 Commissioner Reports  Ruth Luevand – Discussed having
  conversations with the school regarding safety.
  Both Captain Ashrafnia and SRO Magania

  have done a great job with communication
  efforts.

  Orlando Pimental – Discussed the recent
  residential break ins that occurred in West
  Covina. Three suspects broke into 4
  residences, and Pimental wanted the LASD to
  be aware in the case they spill over to San
  Dimas.

  Karol Curtis – Identified that there are still
  traffic issues at Bonita and Cataract due to the
  new Gold Line. She recommended more
  patrol for eastbound traffic, especially during
  rush hour traffic.

 R2 Station Captain’s Report (Captain Ashrafnia) None.

 R3 City Staff Liaison Report (City Manager  City Manager Constantin provided an update
 Chris Constantin)  on the revised camping ordinance that was
  passed by the City Council during the summer.

The meeting adjourned at 7:10 PM.
